# Webhook.site

> > Webhook.site is a platform for testing, transforming, and automating webhooks, HTTP requests, emails, and DNS queries with real-time inspection and workflow capabilities.

Webhook.site provides instant URL endpoints for debugging webhooks and APIs, with support for Custom Actions, integrations with Google Sheets, Slack, Dropbox, S3, SFTP, and more. Available in Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers with features like request forwarding, data transformation, and scheduled workflows.
